## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric *yoga* visualization-practice ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) for the One-Syllable Crown-Wheel-King — focused specifically on the *yújiā guānxíng* ("yoga-visualization") aspect of the practice, distinct from the more general *niànsòng* (recitation) manuals [KR6j0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0130) / [KR6j0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0131).

**Abstract**

The text codifies the visualization-yoga sequences for advanced practitioners of the One-Syllable Crown-Wheel-King — the visualization of the seed-syllable, the cosmic-imperial chariot iconography, and the integration with the practitioner's body via the *bīja*-cakra system. The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Cháng'ān period (746–774).
